context:
Goal: two gaps in Anthropic's session tools that block our work get fixed upstream.
Problem (cannot undo): a report to Anthropic leaves the org, so only you can send it.
Based on (read): the retrospective's ledger rows D19 (Remote Control will not start a session on a turn another session started) and D20 (messages between sessions say only 'delivered'); nothing in this repo can fix either.
Departs from: main has no upstream report for either gap — adds two reports.
Draft D19: "A Claude Code session on Remote Control refuses to start a new session when another session started the current turn. Expected: the start goes through, or the refusal names the rule."
Draft D20: "Messages between sessions report only 'delivered'. The sender cannot tell whether the target read the message. Request: a read receipt, or a 'read' state the sender can query."

options.gain: Both gaps reach the team that can fix them.
options.how: In any Claude Code session, type /bug and paste draft D19; then /bug again and paste draft D20.
options.label: Send both as drafted (recommended)
options.lose: About two minutes of your time.

options.how: Type /bug in any Claude Code session and paste draft D19.
options.label: Send only D19
options.lose: The missing read receipt stays unreported.

options.how: Nothing is sent; the step stays open.
options.label: Hold both

short: Report two session gaps to Anthropic
title: May the two session-tool gaps be reported to Anthropic as drafted?
why: A report to Anthropic leaves the org and cannot be taken back, so you send it.
